verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA documentation includes a kernel-tuning guide for Blackwell GPU architectures, and the DGX B300 docs identify the B300 as a Blackwell Ultra GPU. So the CUDA toolchain plausibly targets this part, but only by inference across two documents. missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing that names B300/Blackwell Ultra, CUDA toolkit version requirements, and hands-on corroboration of shipping CUDA workloads on B300.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship GPU-compute workloads on the vendor's toolchain — CUDA or ROCm/HIP documentation lists this part as a supported target
